text: Pedro's driving test is sometime next week, third attempt. Said he can't sleep thinking about it. Remind me to text him good luck the night before.

Emily back from Lisbon. Flight home was delayed 6 hrs, she landed at 2am and went straight into work the next day. Mad. She said the trip itself was lovely though, rented a little flat in Alfama with her partner and did a day trip to Sintra. They're already talking about going back over the summer, maybe Porto this time.
call w Naledi - her manager Ruth is leaving end of the month, Naledi might go for the role
Salma said Isaac has his grade 8 piano exam early March. He practises every evening after dinner apparently
Kiri passed her theory test!! Practical booked for over the summer
need to pick up passport from the post office before friday

So Amy's audition for the conservatoire is on the 14th and she's been rehearsing nonstop. Her mum is flying over from Dublin the day before to go with her. Amy says she's fine but she was biting her nails the whole time we talked. I should send her something that morning, just a short message, nothing that piles on pressure.
Milan and his wife are off to Japan for three weeks in April, first proper holiday since the twins. Their neighbour is minding the dog, a big old lab called Biscuit.
Sean - new client meeting thurs, he's presenting. hates public speaking
Malik's boss gave him a hard time in his review yesterday. He's thinking about looking elsewhere sometime after Christmas.
don't forget to ask Chioma how her results day went, she was dreading the chemistry one
Demi's flying to Lagos for her cousin's wedding mid November. Long flight, she's not looking forward to the layover in Paris.
Kwame has started at the new firm, in-house legal team. Says the people are nice but the commute is brutal.

Hugo told me the Barcelona trip is off, Tamar's work wouldn't give her the time off because of the merger. He was pretty fed up about it, they'd already paid for the hotel. They're doing a long weekend in the Lakes instead, end of October, and hoping to rebook Spain for early spring. Ask him if they got the hotel money back.
Aleksander (Alek) - vegetarian, doesn't drink, massive F1 fan
remind me to email Ayesha's team lead about the handover before she goes on leave. She's away from the 3rd for two weeks
Tiago had his MOT and driving lesson on the same morning lol. Lesson went fine, car failed
Louis said his sister Zofia got into the Royal Ballet School!! Starting in September. Whole family's going down for the first day

Ethan in the lift: his manager is going on paternity leave sometime next month and Ethan is covering. Bit nervous about it, never managed people before. Should take him for a coffee the week after to see how it's going.
Leah's grandad passed away last weekend. Funeral is on Thursday, she's flying up to Glasgow the day before. Must send flowers.
Ann is taking her CELTA course over the summer, wants to teach English in Vietnam afterwards.
Thabo's wedding anniversary is the 22nd. Ten years. Mariam (his wife) has planned a surprise trip to Cape Town, he doesn't know yet
Booked my flights to Hanoi. Leaving 12 Jan, back early Feb. Need to sort travel insurance sometime this week.
Dong mentioned his daughter's sitting her 11+ in a couple of weeks. He's more stressed than she is honestly

ok so Siddharth got the promotion, senior architect from next month, he's buzzing. His boss told him on Monday and he wasn't allowed to say anything until the announcement this afternoon. Need to organise drinks for him sometime next week, check with Duc which day works because Duc's away the Thursday. Maybe the pub by the station.
ming - allergic to shellfish, remember for the team dinner
Spoke to Pedro after his test. He failed on a roundabout, gutted. Rebooking for early December. Check in with him at the weekend.
Emily's brother Sam is moving to Melbourne at the end of the month. She's taking it harder than she lets on.

voice note: right so Naledi called, she had the interview with the client side this morning, thinks it went okay, they said they'd let her know by the end of the week. Also her flatmate's cat Pepper had kittens, five of them, she's keeping one. Remind me to ask her about the job on Monday.
Salma and Isaac are going to Morocco for New Year. Their first trip abroad as a couple.
Kiri's little brother has his GCSE mocks in January and she's tutoring him maths twice a week
Amy got in!!! Conservatoire said yes. Mum cried apparently. Send congrats card
Note to self: quarterly review with Malik's team moved to the 30th. Prep slides the day before.
Milan says the client from Rotterdam is a nightmare, keeps changing the brief. Mtg w them again early next month.
Sean's presentation went really well, the client signed. He was relieved afterwards. His wife Chioma's due in December btw, first baby.
Demi back from Lagos. Wedding was huge, 600 people. She's jetlagged and has to be back in court the next morning
Kwame - into bouldering, goes Tues and Thurs, wants a new chalk bag
remind me to ring Uncle Hugo sometime this week, his knee op was yesterday
Tamar said her daughter has her driving test on the 18th. Tamar's taking her and has to wait in the car park for an hour afterwards. She's more nervous than the kid
Aleksander's flying to Krakow over half term to see his parents, his dad's not been well. Ask him how his dad's doing when he's back.

Ayesha resigned today. Last day is end of the month, then she's going travelling in South America for six months, starting in Lima and ending up in Patagonia. Her boyfriend Louis is quitting too and going with her. Leaving do sometime the week before. Don't forget to get a card going round the team for her, and maybe a decent travel backpack as a group present.
tiago fernández - new starter in accounts, from Porto, plays 5 a side
Louis said Zofia was really homesick in her first few weeks. Seems to be settling in now.
Ethan's mum is retiring at Christmas after 30 years as a nurse. He wants to get her something special, thinking a weekend in Paris. Should chip in?
Leah's back at work. Quiet. Told me she's struggling to sleep since the funeral.
Ann Williams from the Leeds office is getting married in Crete next June, whole office invited apparently
Thabo's driving test - cancelled by the test centre, examiner off sick. No new date yet
Mariam and her kids are doing a month in Pakistan over the summer, visiting her grandmother.
Dong is learning Spanish on Duolingo, 200 day streak. Going to Mexico City sometime next year.
Siddharth told me Duc has been really down since the restructure. Losing his whole team end of the month. Don't forget to check in with him on Friday.
Ming Le got her bar exam results this morning, passed. Celebration dinner Saturday, I'm bringing dessert.
Long day. Got through the audit, finally. Taking tomorrow off and doing nothing.

Pedro said his girlfriend Kiri has the final round of her law firm interviews early next week. Two days of assessments, then a partner interview the day after. She's terrified about the group exercise. I should text her the morning of the first day, and maybe ask Pedro the week after if she's heard anything back.
Emily's manager Dr Gonzalez is off on sabbatical from January. Emily's going to report to Hugo in the meantime, not thrilled about it.
Sam - hates flying, takes a sleeping pill on anything over 3 hours
Naledi got the job!! Starts first week of December. Her mum is throwing her a little party the weekend before.
Isaac's piano exam went well, he thinks a merit. Results come out a few weeks after.
Chioma had the baby! Little girl, born Tuesday night. Sean's on leave until the end of the month. Must get a gift for them, maybe the cot mobile she mentioned.

Malik's moving to Bristol with his partner sometime in the spring, his partner got a job at the university there. He'll go remote, his manager's already signed it off. They're viewing flats the weekend after next. He's a bit anxious about leaving his mates and his football team behind, but says it's the right call.
Kwame and Demi just got back from their trip, Iceland was incredible apparently. Saw the northern lights the night before they left.
